annotation_description_on_image: two white stars marking the region of steric clash between the EMCV IRES and the 60S subunit
white star icon labeled 'Clash' marking the collision site between the EMCV IRES and the 60S subunit
red 'X' over the reaction arrow indicating that 80S subunit joining is blocked
from_the_caption: On the right, formation of the 80S complex is prevented by a steric clash between the 40S-bound EMCV IRES (red) and the 60S subunit. Release of the EMCV IRES is required to prevent this clash.

annotation_description_on_image: leader line/label 'Met-tRNAi(Met)' pointing to the initiator tRNA density
from_the_caption: Zoomed-in view of the ribosomal positioning of initiator tRNA bound to the EMCV IRES and eIF2α in 48S initiation complexes.

annotation_description_on_image: leader line/label 'Met-tRNAi(Met)' pointing to the initiator tRNA density
from_the_caption: Close-up of the ribosomal positioning of initiator tRNA and eIF5B in 40S ribosomal complexes in the process of subunit joining.

annotation_description_on_image: arrow/label '16.7Å' indicating the magnitude of tRNA displacement
yellow star marking the measured point of tRNA shift
from_the_caption: Superimposition of (H) and (I) showing a 16.7 Å shift in the position of tRNA, which leads to (K) steric interference between the tRNA T-loop and the C548 residue of the EMCV IRES tetraloop-containing subdomain after eIF2 is replaced by eIF5B, disrupting the stable tetraloop-tRNA contact.

annotation_description_on_image: leader line/label 'C548' pointing to the indicated nucleotide
yellow star marking the site of steric interference with the tRNA T-loop
from_the_caption: steric interference between the tRNA T-loop and the C548 residue of the EMCV IRES tetraloop-containing subdomain after eIF2 is replaced by eIF5B, disrupting the stable tetraloop-tRNA contact.
